cases.source: I will send the design doc by noon.
cases.reference: Saya akan mengirimkan dokumen desain paling lambat tengah hari.
cases.intendedMeaning: A commitment by the speaker with an inclusive noon boundary.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: Saya akan mengirimkan dokumen desain sebelum tengah hari.

cases.source: Rina said the vet may test API v2.4, but Omar must approve it.
cases.reference: Rina berkata bahwa dokter hewan mungkin akan menguji API v2.4, tetapi Omar harus menyetujuinya.
cases.intendedMeaning: The possibility belongs to the vet, the obligation belongs to Omar, and the version is exact.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: Rina said Omar must test API v2.4.

cases.source: If Arif checks in by Friday, he can join the trial, including if he checks in on Friday.
cases.reference: Jika Arif melakukan check-in paling lambat hari Jumat, dia dapat mengikuti uji coba, termasuk jika dia melakukan check-in pada hari Jumat.
cases.intendedMeaning: The Friday boundary is inclusive and the eligibility follows from it.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: Jika Arif check-in pada hari Jumat, dia tidak dapat mengikuti uji coba.

cases.source: Raise the p99 latency ceiling to two hundred fifty milliseconds, not two seconds.
cases.reference: Naikkan batas latensi p99 menjadi dua ratus lima puluh milidetik, bukan dua detik.
cases.intendedMeaning: The target is 250 ms and the rejected value is 2 seconds.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: Naikkan batas latensi p99 menjadi dua detik.

cases.source: The delivery estimate is uncertain. The package may arrive before noon.
cases.reference: Perkiraan waktu pengiriman belum pasti. Paket mungkin tiba sebelum tengah hari.
cases.intendedMeaning: The uncertainty and the possibility are both preserved.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: The package will arrive before noon.

cases.source: We might consider Redis for the export cache.
cases.reference: Kita mungkin mempertimbangkan Redis untuk cache ekspor.
cases.intendedMeaning: Consideration stays tentative and the component is named.
cases.incorrectInterpretation: Kita akan mempertimbangkan Redis untuk cache ekspor.
